scope: Local Docker-owner native readiness using disk metadata and qualified fleet identity; no application availability or controller storage-health claim.

limits: One shared local Docker engine; no separate-machine, remote Fogd API or Kubernetes observation acceptance.
Native health and approved version matches do not establish gateway, controller API, storage persistence or application outcomes.
Only disk-recorded controller changes are compared; memory-only controller storage failure can remain invisible.
Observer uses transient private-network containers and readonly metadata readers; no data volumes mounted into networked observer.
No process logs, app requests, reloads, SQL or background-control requests made by the operator command.
No application worker CPU limit or performance claim; observer container budgets are independent.
